basics.name: Gunvansh Siingh
basics.title: Vice President at Citi
basics.summary: Experienced Team Lead & Full-Stack Developer with a proven track record in the information technology and services industry. I bring a strong engineering foundation backed by a Master of Science in Computer Science from Concordia University, along with hands-on expertise in building and leading scalable, high-impact software solutions. I bring a comprehensive skill set, combining proficiency in various programming languages, frameworks, and tools. My experience is enriched by a solid foundation in methodologies such as Agile Software Development and a deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design Patterns. Let's connect to explore how I can drive innovation and deliver top-notch solutions for your team.

bullets: Led end-to-end management of Citi’s global public portals, overseeing architecture, development, stability, and compliance across multiple regions.
Architected and delivered scalable solutions using React and Java Spring Boot , integrating Kafka, Elasticsearch, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS S3 to ensure high availability and performance.
Directed and mentored distributed teams across 4 countries, driving agile delivery, improving collaboration, and ensuring 24/7 production support for global platforms.
Led security governance including VA testing, compliance audits, and vulnerability remediation across all public-facing portals, ensuring adherence to enterprise and regulatory standards
Managed and enhanced in-house CMS platforms while implementing DevOps best practices, automated testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate releases and improve deployment reliability.
Built SEO-optimized and server-side rendered features using Next.js and React, improving performance and page load speed.
Led development of SpryWallet, a native, enterprise-grade payment engine embedded within SpryCIS and SpryEngage, supporting millions of utility payments annually across multiple U.S. states.
Architected end-to-end meter-to-cash payment workflows, enabling one-time, recurring, and autopay transactions across online and in-person channels, increasing payment completion rates by 30%+.

Built and scaled high-availability payment services, integrating Worldpay for Platforms, Paymentus, Moneris, Cybersource, Chase, Apple Pay, and SpryWallet, reliably handling high-volume peak billing traffic.
Implemented risk-based fraud detection, transaction caps, and flexible fee models, helping utilities reduce chargebacks and payment cost leakage by 25%+.
Collaborated with utility partners serving hundreds of thousands of customer accounts, ensuring PCI-aware design, regulatory compliance, and financial-grade reliability.
Led development initiatives at Article.com, driving a 20% surge in website traffic.
Integrated React and Play Framework with Java (Spring) on AWS, enhancing scalability by 37% and boosting app performance by 90%.
Slashed backend query response times by 15%, elevating user experience by 73%.
Mentored junior developers, fostering skill growth and teamwork.
Orchestrated SEO campaigns, elevating organic search traffic by 25% and generating $0.8M in sales.
Conducted technical interviews, ensuring top-tier talent acquisition.
Oversaw Notify-Me project from conception to launch, achieving 95% user satisfaction and $1.5M in sales.
Collaborated cross-functionally with product managers, UI/UX designers, and QA engineers to align development efforts with project goals and business objectives.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams for seamless project alignment and delivery.
Optimized the Tecsys framework UTOPIA, achieving a 660ms reduction in API response time (from 800ms to 120ms), resulting in a 75% improvement.
Led a cross-functional team of 2 designers, 3 back-end developers, and 3 front-end developers to deliver 2 complex features on time and 10% under budget.
Designed back-end logic and UI leveraging OOP and best practices, achieving a 25% reduction in code complexity.
Integrated BDD for full-stack testing, attaining 80% coverage and streamlining development through improved testability.
Acted as a primary point of contact for client engagements, understanding their requirements, providing technical guidance, and ensuring customer satisfaction.
Representing over 10000 graduate students.
Monitoring the activities of Concordia University, other universities, associations, provincial student and non-student organizations by regularly representing GSA in their meetings.
Finding new opportunities and building on existing relationships, with student unions and organizations.
Dealing with sponsors for GSA events, and health Insurance programs and also working with the Student Life Program.
Streamlined development processes by leveraging Spring MVC and Hibernate JPA frameworks, resulting in a 30% increase in development efficiency.
Led the end-to-end design, development, and implementation of high-impact business applications using Java/J2EE, contributing to a 25% reduction in time-to-market.
Drove optimization efforts, troubleshooting, and maintenance of application code, achieving a 40% improvement in system reliability and performance.
Seamlessly deployed applications into staging and production environments, reducing deployment time by 50%.
Automated deployment processes by generating and deploying WAR and EAR files using Maven and Tomcat Application Server, saving 20 hours of manual effort per release cycle.
Ensured robust code quality with comprehensive test coverage, leveraging JUnit to achieve a 95% code coverage rate.
Engineered highly intuitive GUIs using Spring Framework, JSPs, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS, enhancing user satisfaction by 50%.
Tailored and integrated software systems to meet exact end-user specifications, resulting in a 30% increase in user engagement and satisfaction.
Expertly navigated a diverse technology stack including Java, Hibernate, Spring MVC, Spring AOP, Spring Boot, MySQL, Struts, and Git, ensuring seamless integration and functionality across platforms.
Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams within a dynamic Agile environment, facilitating effective communication and alignment of development efforts with project objectives.
Certified Android application development training.
